verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents organization-scoped operation: an API to create organizations and copy settings to an organization, with organization_id sent on every request. This supports running multiple legal entities as separate orgs. Nothing in the evidence shows consolidated financial statements or reporting across organizations, which is the core of the story. missing for 10: consolidated financial reporting across entities, intercompany eliminations, a documented multi-entity management UI, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can manage multiple legal entities and produce consolidated financials across them
